name: Thread tool calls
responsibility: The archboard_app tools a thread calls on the server's other threads: list, read, create, fork, message, wait
description: A creation, fork or message runs only once the user approves it in a pane of the calling thread's tab session, under the generation that may act. A thread it creates or forks works in the checkout of its caller.

outgoing.label: the calling thread's tab session
outgoing.description: The server composes the tab-session owner and passes routing or lookup callbacks through the public runtime or Browser gateway interfaces. Private server code registers and invokes those callbacks; the runtime modules never import codex-workbench-sessions.ts.

outgoing.label: thread/start, fork and turn/start for a tool call
